summary: Frontend-only QA of Tools 'My Brand' batch. Logged in as super admin (forest@imosapp.com) at 390x844 and visited all 12 routes; each renders the shared ScreenHeader with the correct centered title and expected testids. Both bug fixes confirmed: /settings/review-links loads Google/Yelp/Facebook/DealerRater/Cars.com rows (no 'Loading...' stuck state) and exposes review-links-save-btn; /settings/store-profile shows the proper empty state (store-profile-empty + store-profile-go-my-profile). Email Signature preview renders with name 'Forest' and gold initials circle (no broken img). Rep flow (mjeast1985@gmail.com): folder-tile-My Brand -> app-tile-my-digital-card lands on /my-profile (as required), and app-tile-share-my-card lands on /quick-send/digitalcard.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping templates-header-back after direct navigation logs 'GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator' and URL does not change. Only reproducible when opening the screen directly (no history). Not a regression of this batch; router.back() has no fallback when history stack is empty.

After filling a Google Reviews URL and tapping review-links-save-btn, neither a success toast ('Review links updated successfully') nor an error alert ('No store associated...') appeared within 3.5s. No crash. Consider verifying the save path emits UI feedback for the no-store case.

Two elements still use iOS-blue rgb(0,122,255): the 'View My Digital Card' button and a small icon glyph inside the signature preview card. Likely intentional HTML email preview styling (mail-client link blue), but flagged per request.

Console errors: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' (3x) while rendering the Congrats Card screen. Header renders correctly; likely a stray whitespace/text between View children.

Layout children warnings on multiple settings screens: 'No route named "my-profile" / "congrats-template" / "showroom-approvals" exists in nested children'. Not blocking but suggests settings/_layout.tsx is missing these Stack.Screen declarations while other code links to them.

route_header_check./broadcast: Broadcasts OK (broadcasts-header, broadcasts-new-btn, broadcasts-header-back, broadcasts-empty-new-btn all present)
route_header_check./settings/review-links: Review Links OK - fully loaded, save button present, 7 text inputs
route_header_check./settings/store-profile: Store Profile OK - empty state renders with go-my-profile button
route_header_check./email-signature: Email Signature OK - preview shows 'Forest' + gold F initials circle
route_header_check./showroom-manage: My Showcase OK - stats 71 VISIBLE / 1 HIDDEN / 72 TOTAL
route_header_check./share-app: Share the App OK - install link + Copy/Share card + Taps/Installs/Signed up stats
route_header_check./settings/create-card?generic=true: Congrats Card OK (minor console text-node warnings)

rep_flow_check.login: Rep landed on /my-account after login (home-simple not on that route). Home screen rendering not directly re-tested on /home for the rep.

action_items: Verify review-links Save handler surfaces the expected toast/alert (no-store case appears silent).
Optional: add fallback in templates-header-back (router.canGoBack() ? back : replace('/more')) so direct-URL entry still navigates away.
Clean up stray text nodes in settings/create-card (Congrats Card) causing 'Unexpected text node' console errors.
Add missing Stack.Screen entries in settings/_layout.tsx for my-profile / congrats-template / showroom-approvals or update the linking targets.
Confirm the blue color inside the email-signature preview is intentional (email client link default) and, if not, replace with gold theme accent.
critical_code_review_comments: settings/review-links save UX should always provide immediate feedback (toast or inline error) even when no store is associated, otherwise users think Save did nothing.
ScreenHeader back buttons should degrade gracefully when history stack is empty (deep link / refresh).

Remaining items are minor polish: silent Save on review-links for no-store users, text-node warning on Congrats Card, missing Stack.Screen entries, and one blue accent inside the email preview card.
